title: Fast Inference for Augmented Large Language Models
authors: Rana Shahout; Cong Liang; Shiji Xin; Qianru Lao; Yong Cui; Minlan Yu; Michael Mitzenmacher
research_focus: LLM serving, Agentic / Workflow serving, KV cache offloading, Length prediction

problem_statement.en: Augmented LLMs interleave decoding with external API/tool calls, and existing serving systems either waste KV cache memory during API calls or, like InferCept, manage that memory but still schedule requests FCFS, causing head-of-line blocking and long request completion times under load.
problem_statement.zh: Augmented LLM 在 decode 過程中穿插外部 API/工具呼叫，現有服務系統或在 API call 期間浪費 KV cache 記憶體，或如 InferCept 雖管理該記憶體但仍採用 FCFS 排程，導致 head-of-line blocking 並在高負載下顯著拉長請求完成時間。

key_innovation.en: LAMPS unifies API-call memory handling with scheduling: an OPT-125M-based classifier predicts pre-API output length (50 bins of 10 tokens) and per-API-type statistics predict API duration; each request is assigned the memory-waste-minimizing handling strategy (Preserve / Discard-and-Recompute / Swap) before processing, and requests are ranked by predicted memory-consumption-over-time, with a per-request starvation-prevention counter.
key_innovation.zh: LAMPS 將 API call 期間的記憶體處置與排程統一：以 OPT-125M 分類器預測 pre-API 輸出長度（50 個各 10 tokens 的 bins），並依 API 類型統計預測 API 時長；在請求處理前即指派使記憶體浪費最小的處置策略（Preserve / Discard-and-Recompute / Swap），並依預測之 memory-over-time（記憶體使用量對時間的積分）對請求排序，輔以每請求的 starvation 防止計數器。

key_improvements.en: Improves end-to-end latency by 27%-85% and reduces TTFT by 4%-96% compared to InferCept, with greater gains over vLLM; up to 50.23% higher throughput than InferCept on the multi-API dataset.
key_improvements.zh: 相較於 InferCept，端到端延遲改善 27%-85%、TTFT 降低 4%-96%，相較於 vLLM 增益更大；在 multi-API 資料集上吞吐量較 InferCept 最高提升 50.23%。

compute_memory_hw: NVIDIA A100 (80GB, capped at 40GB), AMD EPYC 7313
offload_trigger: A request's KV cache leaves GPU memory when the request encounters an API/tool call during decoding and its pre-assigned handling strategy is Swap (offload to CPU) or Discard (free and later recompute); the strategy is chosen before the request is processed, based on predicted pre-API output length and predicted API duration.
prefetch_signal_timing: Event-driven, not speculative: when the API call finishes, the request re-enters the waiting queue and its KV is swapped back in (or recomputed for Discard) once the scheduler admits it; predicted API duration is used only ahead of time to pick the handling strategy, not to prefetch before the API returns.
agent_awareness: Exploits that augmented-LLM API calls fall into fixed classes (math, QA, virtual environment, chatbot, image generation, TTS, ToolBench tools) with low intra-class duration variance, enabling per-type API-duration prediction; pre-API output length is predicted from the prompt via OPT-125M, and multi-API requests are segmented per API call.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Before a request runs, evaluate the predicted memory waste of Preserve (idle memory over API duration), Discard-and-Recompute (recomputation forward-pass cost), and Swap (transfer stall cost) using InferCept's waste equations with predicted pre-API length and API duration, assign the minimum-waste strategy, and rank requests for scheduling by their memory-over-time integral under that strategy.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: 在請求執行前，以 InferCept 的 waste 方程式結合預測之 pre-API 長度與 API 時長，評估 Preserve（API 期間閒置記憶體）、Discard-and-Recompute（重算 forward-pass 成本）與 Swap（傳輸停頓成本）的預測記憶體浪費，指派浪費最小的策略，並依該策略下的 memory-over-time 積分對請求進行排程排序。
